blocks.md: When you leave a place or someone leaves, you say **'Goodbye'** or **'Bye-bye'**.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: You can go home now. Goodbye, Aisha.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: The lesson is over. Goodbye, children.

lines.speaker: Jibril
lines.text: I love the story, Mallam Idris.

lines.speaker: Mallam Idris
lines.text: Good. You have to go now. Bye-bye, Jibril.

blocks.md: **Remember:** Always say goodbye politely. You can wave your hand as well.

quiz.q: What do you say when leaving?
What did the class say when the lesson ended?

quiz.explain: You say goodbye when leaving a place.
